name: the count is off by one
no seal check
from: assert(disclose(commitOf(h, s, kernel.self().bytes) == commits.lookup(s)), "this is not the hand sealed at this slot");

name: any count
from: assert(disclose(countOf(h.values, target) == n), "that is not this slot's count");

name: answer late
from: assert(blockTimeLt(answerBy), "too late: the answer window has closed");

name: answer before the question
equivalent: answerBy is 0 until the question is asked, so the window check refuses an early answer anyway; after finish, every slot has answered or the window has closed

name: a zero seal
from: assert(c != default<Bytes<32>>, "a seal must be a commitment");

name: ask twice
from: assert(phase == Phase.sealing, "the question has already been asked");

name: a time in the future
from: assert(blockTimeGte(n), "declared time is in the future");

name: a stale time
from: assert(blockTimeLt((n + clockSlack) as Uint<64>), "declared time is stale");

name: finish early
from: assert(answeredCount.read() == sealedCount.read() || blockTimeGte(answerBy), "slots can still answer");
